unread.db_pool: Consumed by injection — passed to wire_execution_spine and _wire_sqlite_durable_events before the Container is constructed. The field is an unread second reference, kept because downstream products construct a Container and reach the pool through it.
unread.elevation_store: Consumed by injection — passed to Sentinel at construction. The field is an unread second reference.
unread.golden_record_store: InMemoryGoldenRecordStore is constructed and only stored. No production reader.
unread.harness_registry: Returned by _wire_hierarchy alongside `hierarchy` and only stored. No production reader; the orchestrator surface is reached through maistro.orchestrator directly.
unread.hierarchy: HierarchicalOrchestrator is returned by _wire_hierarchy and only stored. No production reader; the orchestrator surface is reached through maistro.orchestrator directly.
unread.identity_linker: IdentityLinker is constructed and only stored. No production reader.
unread.node_template_store: Consumed by the importing product and by the rest of #556. Core has no NodeTemplate-facing route: the catalog surface (AC-8), the legacy adapter (AC-10) and the improvement-candidate path (AC-11) are the readers, and each is a separate item on that issue. Exposed now rather than after them because the store is what makes AC-12 checkable at all -- a NodeTemplate that survives a restart is the precondition for provenance resolving after one -- and a durable store no deployment can reach would be the defect this ledger exists to keep visible.
unread.pii_detector: PIIDetector(mode='prod') is constructed and only stored. The PII filter on the request path builds its own detector; this field duplicates it and nothing reads it.
unread.project_scope_store: Consumed by injection — returned by wire_execution_spine and passed to wire_chat_admission. The field is an unread second reference.
unread.resilience_policies: InMemoryResiliencePolicyStore is constructed with the default policy set and only stored. No production reader; ADR-038's circuit-breaking reads its policies through maistro.resilience.
unread.spawn_harness_node: AgentSpawnHarnessNode is constructed from the wired adapters and only stored. No production reader.
unread.template_store: Bound from wire_execution_spine's `graph_template_store` and only stored. The scheduler admission path takes its GraphTemplateStore by constructor injection instead (maistro.scheduling.admission), so this field is a second reference nothing follows.
